# Rosetta Research

> **Purpose**: Acquire the facts a Rosetta knowledge base needs, return them as one NRRA + a closed coverage ledger, and on success apply that NRRA into `fact-graph.json` via `write-graph.py --apply-nrra`. Fanout is a Mastra program shipped in this plugin, not a harness `Task` hint.
>
> **NO-STUB INVARIANT.** Every fact traces to a real source locator. Unknowns go in `gaps[]`. If the engine cannot run, STOP with a named reason and write nothing.

## Inputs

```
INPUT: technology_name     (e.g. "GPUI", "Next.js")  OR a bare URL
INPUT: repository_url      (optional — local clone preferred via --repo-path)
INPUT: docs_url            (optional)
INPUT: base_framework      (what to map FROM)
INPUT: topics              (optional — skip census; fan out exactly these)
INPUT: depth               (quick | normal | deep — default normal)
INPUT: model               (REQUIRED — the invoking session's model; never default)
INPUT: --no-graph          (optional — skip --apply-nrra; nested bootstrap/upgrade MUST pass this)
```

# kb:ceiling: nested callers need an explicit --no-graph
# idempotent apply alone cannot preserve upgrade's accept/improve/roll-back gate

A bare `https://…` argument is classified: github/gitlab/bitbucket → repo, anything else → docs site. `/rosetta:research https://nextjs.org/docs` is a docs run, not a tech named "https://…".

`--topics` maps to caller-supplied `directives[]` and skips census. A repo/docs target leaves `directives` unset so census generates them.

## One path

There is no 3-tier ladder. There is no "floor parallelism you MAY enable". The engine is the only path.

```
[0] LOCATE THE ENGINE
    RESOLVER = first existing of "$ROSETTA_CONFIG",
               "<this skill's dir>/assets/rosetta_config.py",
               "${ROSETTA_HOME:-$HOME/.rosetta}/bin/rosetta_config.py"
    PLUGIN   = $(python3 "$RESOLVER" plugin)
               # $ROSETTA_PLUGIN → $ROSETTA_HOME/plugin-root (recorded by install.sh)
               # → walking up from the resolver. Each candidate must really contain the engine.
    ENGINE   = "$PLUGIN/engine/src/research.ts"
    IF that command exits non-zero, or the file is missing:
        STOP. Print:
          "engine absent. From the plugin checkout run: ./install.sh  (records the plugin root)
           then: cd engine && bun install
           This skill will not improvise a serial crawl, and will not go hunting the filesystem
           for the engine."
        Write nothing.

    An INSTALLED skill is only SKILL.md + assets/ — walking up from it never reaches engine/.
    The recorded plugin root is the supported way to find it; a `find` across the disk is not.

[1] DETECT HARNESS + MODEL
    Pass --harness {claude|codex|opencode|grok|pi} if you know it; otherwise the engine
    reads CLAUDECODE / CODEX_* / OPENCODE_* / GROK_* / PI_* / CMUX_AGENT_LAUNCH_KIND.
    Pass --model {the model THIS session is using}. Never omit it. Never invent one.
    With --harness pi, optionally pass --provider {provider} — the engine composes
    provider/model. Model-provided harnesses ignore --provider.

[2] BUILD THE INVOCATION
    bun run "$ENGINE" \
      --tech "{technology_name}" \
      --tech-slug "{kebab}" \
      --model "{model}" \
      [--provider "{provider}"] \
      [--harness {harness}] \
      [--base-framework "{base}"] \
      [--repo-path "{local clone}"] \
      [--repo-url "{url}"] \
      [--docs-url "{url}"] \
      [--topics "{comma topics}"] \
      [--depth {quick|normal|deep}] \
      [--concurrency N] \
      [--census-only] \
      --out-dir "{resolved research dir}/{slug}-run"

    Storage destination is resolved by assets/rosetta_config.py (project / device / path).
    Never hardcode ~/Projects/brain.
    Omit `--concurrency` unless the caller asked for a one-off override. The
    engine reads `limits.concurrency` from project then device config
    (`~/.rosetta/config.json`), then `$ROSETTA_CONCURRENCY`, then 8.

[3] CONSUME STDOUT
    The engine prints JSON: { runId, status, nrra, ledger, blockReason, directiveCount, perClass }.
    status=BLOCKED → STOP. Surface blockReason. Write nothing else (do not call apply).
    Open ledger → STOP. Write nothing else.
    Otherwise write nrra.md + ledger.json (already in --out-dir) and continue to [4].

[4] APPLY NRRA → GRAPH (required unless --no-graph)
    IF --no-graph was passed → skip this step; return the NRRA to the caller.
    # kb:ceiling: nested callers need an explicit --no-graph
    # idempotent apply alone cannot preserve upgrade's accept/improve/roll-back gate
    python3 "$PLUGIN/scripts/rosetta/write-graph.py" --apply-nrra {slug} \
      --nrra {out}/nrra.md --ledger {out}/ledger.json
    Absent dest → create semantics. Existing dest → additive merge (no deletes);
    v.pkg/v.version moves are reported, not auto-written.
    The skill never writes fact-graph.json itself — only write-graph.py does.
    Do NOT pass --root. With no --root the writer asks rosetta_config.py for the docs class, so
    the KB lands where the config says. Passing --root pins it to that repo and overrides config.
```

## Failure

| Failure | Response |
|---|---|
| engine/ missing, or `rosetta_config.py plugin` fails | STOP + install instructions. Never crawl, never `find` for it. |
| `--model` omitted (empty) | engine exits 2 naming MODEL_MISSING (model is never defaulted) |
| unknown model string | passes through to the ACP binary; provider errors surface as classified AUTH / MODEL / QUOTA messages |
| harness has no ACP entrypoint | engine preflight STOP (named). Nothing written. |
| already inside a worker (`ROSETTA_WORKER=1`) | STOP (recursion) |
| ledger open at emit | status=BLOCKED, no graph write |

## Output contract

Unchanged NRRA shape (mental model, v/w/r/a/x/t tables, seed JSON, gaps, sources) **plus** `run_id` and `decoder_ring_hash` in the frontmatter. Downstream delivery into agent bodies is a **generated render** (`scripts/kb-delivery/generate_excerpt.py` + `embed-graph.sh`), sized per-role at render time — research must not self-limit graph richness to fit a token budget.

## Storage resolution

```
RESOLVER = first existing of "$ROSETTA_CONFIG",
           "<this skill's dir>/assets/rosetta_config.py",
           "${ROSETTA_HOME:-$HOME/.rosetta}/bin/rosetta_config.py"
DEST = $(python3 "$RESOLVER" path --class research --slug {tech_slug} --ensure)
```

Record the resolved absolute path. Do not lie about where the artifact landed.

## Usage

```
/rosetta:research "GPUI" --repo-url https://github.com/zed-industries/zed --base-framework React
/rosetta:research https://nextjs.org/docs
/rosetta:research "Tauri v2" --topics "state management, IPC security"
```
